show sunday
scene earlymorning
When the morning comes and most of the girls are sleeping, there is one who wanders off.
lines.zh: 清晨到来,大多数女孩还在睡梦中时,有一个人独自走开了。

lines.en: She’s not unused to waking up at this hour of the day — she’s been doing it since she was a child.
lines.zh: 她并非不习惯在一天中的这个时刻醒来——从孩提时代起,她就一直是这样。

lines.en: A checklist posted on the door of a tiny kitchen would remind her of what needed to be done before she went to school each morning.
lines.zh: 一间小小的厨房门上贴着一张清单,提醒她每天早上上学前需要做什么。

lines.en: Make your bed.
lines.zh: 整理床铺。

lines.en: Do your homework.
lines.zh: 做作业。

lines.en: Make breakfast.
lines.zh: 做早餐。

lines.en: Take a shower.
lines.zh: 洗澡。

lines.en: Get dressed.
lines.zh: 换衣服。

lines.en: And it wasn’t like she would forget to do these things if the list did not exist — she just simply liked having something to correspond with since it was always silent around this time.
lines.zh: 倒不是说没有这张清单她就会忘了做这些事——她只是喜欢有点东西可以一一对照,因为这个时间点周围一向很安静。

lines.en: It wasn’t as fulfilling as talking to someone, but it was still something. And she {i}did{/i} have scattered phone calls to look forward to every now and then when the times lined up.
lines.zh: 那当然不如和人说话来得满足,但总归是点什么。而且时不时的,要是时间对得上,她{i}还能{/i}期待几通零散的电话。

lines.en: They just often didn’t.
lines.zh: 只是往往对不上。

lines.en: As the years went by, more items were added to her morning lists.
lines.zh: 随着年岁流逝,她早晨的清单上多了更多条目。

lines.en: Read a chapter of a book.
lines.zh: 读一章书。

lines.en: Exercise for thirty minutes.
lines.zh: 锻炼三十分钟。

lines.en: Check your messages and emails.
lines.zh: 查看消息和邮件。

lines.en: As her mornings grew busier, she accepted that some days, she would have to skip certain entries in order to make it to class on time.
lines.zh: 随着早晨越来越忙,她也接受了:有些日子,为了准时到校,她必须跳过其中某些项。

lines.en: It was okay if she didn’t make her bed.
lines.zh: 不整理床铺也没关系。

lines.en: It was okay if she didn’t make breakfast.
lines.zh: 不做早餐也没关系。

lines.en: It was okay if she {i}never{/i} made breakfast.
lines.zh: {i}永远{/i}不做早餐也没关系。

lines.en: There are tons of people who don’t eat breakfast. Plus, there were other meals later on in the day that would be more than enough to fill her up.
lines.zh: 不吃早餐的人多的是。再说,一天里还有别的餐,足够把她填饱。

lines.en: Everything would be fine in the end because she wasn’t doing anything wrong.
lines.zh: 最后一切都会没事的,因为她并没有做错什么。

lines.en: But then she was.
lines.zh: 可后来她做了。

lines.en: And today-
lines.zh: 而今天——

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath1
Today is a day where the list does not exist.
lines.zh: 今天,是一张清单并不存在的日子。

lines.en: But, as she remembers what is meant to be on it, she has decided to begin her morning with a bath — long before anyone would have a chance of seeing her.
lines.zh: 但当她回想起清单上本该有什么时,她决定以泡澡开启这个早晨——赶在任何人有机会看见她之前很久。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath2
Or so she thought.
lines.zh: 至少她是这么想的。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath3
You see, this girl wasn’t the only person used to being awake at this time of day.
lines.zh: 要知道,习惯在这个时间醒着的,并不只有这个女孩。

lines.en: But the one who beat her to the punch on this particular morning was never good at waking up early.
lines.zh: 但今天早上抢在她前面的那位,从来都不擅长早起。

lines.en: In fact, most nights, she didn’t sleep at all.
lines.zh: 事实上,大多数夜晚,她根本没睡。

lines.en: Last night, it happened again — but for reasons much different than the ones she’s grown used to.
lines.zh: 昨晚,这种事又发生了——只是原因和她习惯的那些大不相同。

lines.en: Just like the other girl, she wasn’t particularly comfortable with baring her full self in front of others.
lines.zh: 和另一个女孩一样,她也不太习惯在别人面前袒露完整的自己。

lines.en: And just like the other girl, she wasn’t particularly comfortable with doing that in front of {i}herself{/i} either.
lines.zh: 而和另一个女孩一样,她也不太习惯在{i}自己{/i}面前那样做。

lines.en: The only times she’d be caught gazing into mirrors were when her morbid curiosity would reach its peak.
lines.zh: 她唯一会盯着镜子看的时候,是病态的好奇心达到顶点的时候。

lines.en: And as she’d stare into the eyes of someone she only partially recognized, she’d remember why she was so alone despite her age.
lines.zh: 而当她凝视着一双自己只认得一半的眼睛时,她就会想起,为什么到了这个年纪的自己依然如此孤独。

lines.en: : Miss Imai?...
lines.zh: : Imai 老师?……

lines.en: The two of them were similar in a number of ways.
lines.zh: 她们两个在很多方面都很相似。

lines.en: They both liked to read.
lines.zh: 她们都喜欢读书。

lines.en: They both found the scent of cinnamon relaxing and nostalgic.
lines.zh: 她们都觉得肉桂的香气让人放松,又带着怀旧的味道。

lines.en: And they both preferred to pleasure themselves in the morning instead of the night.
lines.zh: 而且她们都喜欢在早晨而不是夜里取悦自己。

lines.en: But always with their clothes on.
lines.zh: 但总是穿着衣服。

lines.en: There was one key difference, though.
lines.zh: 不过,有一个关键的区别。

lines.en: For one of them, this trait was something they were born with.
lines.zh: 对其中一个人来说,这个特质是天生的。

lines.en: : Heeeey...what are {i}you{/i} doing up so early?
lines.zh: : 嘿——嘿……{i}你{/i}这么早起来做什么?

lines.en: For the other, it was gained.
lines.zh: 对另一个人来说,它是后天获得的。

lines.en: scene black
: I always wake up around this time...What about you?
lines.zh: : 我一直是这个时间左右醒来的……你呢?

lines.en: : I wasn’t really...expecting anyone else to be in here yet.
lines.zh: : 我倒真没想到……这个时候会有人在这儿。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath4
: Yeah...same here.
lines.zh: : 是啊……彼此彼此。

lines.en: : Uhh...just out of curiosity, is...is anybody {i}else{/i} on their way too? Or...
lines.zh: : 呃……只是好奇,还……还有{i}别人{/i}要来吗?还是……

lines.en: : No...I came here alone. And apart from Ayane who’s still missing, the rest of the girls in my room aren’t awake yet.
lines.zh: : 没有……我是一个人来的。除了还下落不明的 Ayane,我房间里其他女生都还没醒。

lines.en: : Ayane’s not back yet? Seriously?
lines.zh: : Ayane 还没回来?真的假的?

lines.en: : Yeah...but Ami seemed pretty adamant that she’d be okay, so...
lines.zh: : 是啊……不过 Ami 看起来非常坚持说她会没事,所以……

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}You girls and these damn risky contests. I’m gonna have to be a lot stricter for the next Dorm Wars, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}你们这些丫头和这些该死的危险比赛。下一届宿舍战争我得严格多了,是吧?

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath5
: Sorry for making this harder on you when you already work so much.
lines.zh: : 你已经工作那么多了,还让你更难做,真抱歉。

lines.en: : It’s fine, it’s fine. You’re one of the good ones. I just hope Ayane isn’t {i}too{/i} lost or we’re gonna have to replace all of today’s contests with a competitive search party instead.
lines.zh: : 没事,没事。你是好孩子之一。我只希望 Ayane 别迷路得{i}太{/i}厉害,不然我们今天所有的比赛都得换成一场竞赛式的搜救行动了。

lines.en: : That’s not a bad idea...turning it into a competition. With Sensei on the line, I’m sure both floors would tear apart the whole forest in a matter of hours.
lines.zh: : 那主意不坏……把它变成比赛。有 Sensei 当赌注,我敢说两层楼的人几小时内就能把整片林子翻个底朝天。

lines.en: : Yeah. You’re all pretty obsessed with him, after all. And that {i}really{/i} shines when you guys do stuff like this.
lines.zh: : 是啊。毕竟你们都喜欢他喜欢得要命。你们干这种事的时候,这一点{i}真是{/i}闪闪发光。

lines.en: : Some of the girls get...a little more competitive than others in our group outings. But, for the most part I...try not to get in the way of that.
lines.zh: : 我们集体出行的时候,有些女生会……比别人更好胜一点。不过大体上我……尽量不去妨碍她们。

lines.en: : I hear you there, Futaba. Can barely talk to him at these things without worrying somebody’s gonna show up out of nowhere and stab me in the back.
lines.zh: : 我懂你,Futaba。在这种场合我几乎不敢跟他说话,生怕有人突然冒出来在背后捅我一刀。

lines.en: : Well...if it’s any consolation, I promise I came here unarmed and that your back is safe for now.
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果这算安慰的话,我保证我是空着手来的,而且你的后背暂时是安全的。

lines.en: : Thanks, Futaba. I promise I won’t try to assassinate you either.
lines.zh: : 谢谢,Futaba。我也保证不会试图暗杀你。

lines.en: : I’m glad we were able to reach a truce.
lines.zh: : 很高兴我们能达成休战。

lines.en: : Just for the Dorm Wars, of course. But once this is over? You better watch your back.
lines.zh: : 当然,只限宿舍战争期间。不过等这事一结束?你最好小心你的后背。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath6
: Hahah...got it. I’ll be keeping an eye on you.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……明白了。我会盯着你的。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath7
: Things not to say in the bath, volume one.
lines.zh: : 浴室里不该说的话,第一卷。

lines.en: : Hahah! You’re right, you’re right. We should be more careful with our words or one of us might get the wrong idea.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈!你说得对,你说得对。我们该更小心措辞,不然其中一个可能会误会。

lines.en: : Absolutely. I like you and all, Futaba. You’re just a little too young for me.
lines.zh: : 绝对同意。我喜欢你这个人,Futaba。只是你对我来说年纪有点太小了。

lines.en: : And you’re a little too-
lines.zh: : 而你有那么一点太——

lines.en: : Black?
: Wha- no! Miss Imai! I was going to say “feminine!”
lines.zh: : 什——不是!Imai 老师!我本来想说的是『有女人味』!

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath8
: I’m sorry, I’m sorry. But how could I {i}not{/i} jump on you with an opportunity like that?
lines.zh: : 抱歉,抱歉。不过这种机会摆在面前,我怎么能{i}不{/i}扑上去呢?

lines.en: : Things not to say in the bath, volume two.
lines.zh: : 浴室里不该说的话,第二卷。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath9
: Heeey! Look at us! We’ve got our own little inside joke now! It’s only a matter of time at this point until we’re forming a tennis doubles team or riding a tandem bicycle together.
lines.zh: : 嘿——嘿!看看我们!我们现在有自己的小内部笑话了!照这个进度,我们组个网球双打、或者一起骑双人自行车,也只是时间问题了。

lines.en: : Ahh, yes. The natural progression of friendship. It feels like just yesterday I was having my first bike ride with Nodoka.
lines.zh: : 啊,是啊。友谊的自然进程。感觉就像昨天,我才和 Nodoka 第一次骑自行车。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath10
: Let me guess — she took the seat off and rode the pole directly.
lines.zh: : 让我猜猜——她把坐垫拆了,直接骑在那根杆子上。

lines.en: : Haha, that does sound like something she’d do, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哈哈,那听起来确实像她会干的事,不是吗?

lines.en: : Girl’s so thirsty I wouldn’t be surprised if part of it came off and just got permanently stuck in there.
lines.zh: : 那丫头饥渴成那样,就算有一截杆子断在里面永久卡住,我也不会惊讶。

lines.en: : You’re right about that. But at least we can admire her...tenacity?
lines.zh: : 这点你说得对。不过至少我们可以欣赏她的……坚韧?

lines.en: : Is that what we’re calling it now? {i}Tenacity?{/i}
lines.zh: : 我们现在是这么称呼它了吗?{i}坚韧{/i}?

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath5
: That’s what {i}I’m{/i} calling it because I’ve known her for so long that I can’t help but give her the benefit of the doubt.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}就是这么称呼的,因为我认识她太久了,忍不住会往好处想她。

lines.en: : And even {i}if{/i} Nodoka is being serious about all of that stuff-
lines.zh: : 而且{i}就算{/i} Nodoka 对那些事是认真的——

lines.en: : Which she is.
lines.zh: : 她确实是。

lines.en: : {i}Maybe.{/i} But even if she is being serious, I can’t help but admire her...willingness to be open about her interests and...
lines.zh: : {i}也许吧。{/i}但就算她是认真的,我还是忍不住佩服她的……那种愿意公开自己兴趣的坦率,还有……

lines.en: : And that...extreme confidence she has about everything.
lines.zh: : 还有她那份……对一切都极端自信的样子。

lines.en: : Like she’s aware of how amazing she is in every way and just...leverages it every chance she gets.
lines.zh: : 就像她清楚自己在各方面有多厉害,然后……一有机会就加以利用。

lines.en: : I admire her encyclopedic intellect, for sure. But all that {i}confidence{/i} and {i}tenacity{/i} make me want to punt her sometimes. Kirin too.
lines.zh: : 我确实佩服她百科全书般的学识。但那份{i}自信{/i}和{i}坚韧{/i}有时真让我想把她踹飞。Kirin 也是。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath11
: Hahah...that’s fair.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……这倒公道。

lines.en: : I might just be biased since those are qualities I’ve always longed for myself...but I can’t help but look up to Nodoka. Even {i}with{/i} her many apparent flaws.
lines.zh: : 也许我有点偏心,因为这些正是我一直渴望拥有的品质……但我还是忍不住仰慕 Nodoka。哪怕她{i}有{/i}那么多显而易见的缺点。

lines.en: : You long to be a horny human-computer?
lines.zh: : 你渴望成为一台发情的人形电脑?

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath12
: Wha- no. Obviously not. What I {i}really{/i} want is her confidence. She’s amazing at everything and always knows how to use that to her advantage.
lines.zh: : 什——不是。当然不是。我{i}真正{/i}想要的是她的自信。她什么都厉害,而且永远知道怎么把这一点为己所用。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath13
: Confidence? What don’t you have to be confident about? You’re kind and smart and driven and a billion other things everybody else wants to be but totally sucks at. Nodoka included.
lines.zh: : 自信?你有什么好不自信的?你善良、聪明、有干劲,还有一百万种别人想成为却完全做不到的特质。Nodoka 也包括在内。
: 那是……

lines.en: : It’s less...what’s on the inside and...
lines.zh: : 与其说是……内在的东西,不如说……

lines.en: : More of...what everyone can see...
lines.zh: : 更像是……所有人都能看见的东西……

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath14
: Futaba, no way...{i}You?{/i}
lines.zh: : Futaba,不会吧……{i}你{/i}?

lines.en: : Do you really mean that?
lines.zh: : 你真的这么想吗?

lines.en: : I-I’m not trying to vent or anything! It’s just...you asked, so...
lines.zh: : 我、我不是想发牢骚什么的!只是……你问了,所以……

lines.en: : It’s {i}fine{/i} to vent. I’m your teacher and I care about you. I just...never would have expected that.
lines.zh: : 发牢骚也{i}没关系{/i}。我是你的老师,我关心你。我只是……完全没想到。

lines.en: : I-I don’t blame you! Not at all! You’re just...you’re so beautiful that...I can’t imagine stupid things like this ever even cross your mind.
lines.zh: : 我、我不怪你!一点都不!你只是……你太美了,我无法想象这种蠢事也会掠过你的脑海。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath15
: I’m not beautiful.
lines.zh: : 我不美。

lines.en: : Not even close.
lines.zh: : 差得远了。

lines.en: : What are you talking about? Of course you are. You’re slim and stylish...and your eyes are such a gorgeous shade of blue. Not to mention your {i}hair.{/i} Everything about you is perfect and I’m-
lines.zh: : 你在说什么?你当然美。你苗条又时髦……而且你的眼睛是那种极美的蓝色。更别说你的{i}头发{/i}了。你的一切都很完美,而我——

lines.en: : {i}Actually{/i} beautiful.
lines.zh: : 是{i}真正的{/i}美。

lines.en: : Not the kind of “beautiful” that has to pay close attention to every aspect of her person just to make sure people focus more on the flashy parts than the hideous ones.
lines.zh: : 不是那种必须紧盯着自己身上每一处,才能确保别人把注意力放在光鲜的部分、而不是丑陋部分上的『美』。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath16
: What would I even distract anyone {i}with?{/i} How am I supposed to know what to make people focus on when I can barely even look at myself in the mirror?
lines.zh: : 我又能{i}拿什么{/i}去转移别人的注意力?我连镜子里的自己都几乎看不下去,又怎么知道该让人把目光放在哪里?

lines.en: : If you’re not looking in the mirror, you’re missing out. Your skin? Flawless. Your hair? Beautiful and silky and soft. And those eyes? Well, let’s just say I ain’t the only one here who’s lucky in that area.
lines.zh: : 如果你不看镜子,那你可亏大了。你的皮肤?完美无瑕。你的头发?漂亮、柔顺又丝滑。至于那双眼睛?嗯,只能说在这点上走运的可不止你一个人。

lines.en: : Also, you’re rockin’ friggin’ F’s or something. And you don’t even {i}need{/i} to try and get people to focus on those since they’re always going to anyway. Ain’t nobody starin’ at my chest.
lines.zh: : 而且你可是顶着那啥 F 罩杯之类的。你根本{i}不用{/i}费劲让人注意它们,因为无论如何别人都会看。反倒是没人在盯着我的胸。

lines.en: : Thank you...for all of that. But I just don’t see it that way.
lines.zh: : 谢谢……你说的这一切。只是我没法那样看待自己。

lines.en: : What {i}I{/i} see when I look in the mirror is...
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}在镜子里看到的,是……

lines.en: : It’s disgusting...
lines.zh: : 是恶心……

lines.en: : I used to be skinny. Or...skinny-{i}ish{/i} at least...
lines.zh: : 我以前很瘦。或者……至少算{i}偏{/i}瘦……

lines.en: : I eat healthy...I exercise...and I’ve even...resorted to...{i}other{/i} methods in the past...but nothing works.
lines.zh: : 我吃得健康……我运动……我甚至……过去还用过……{i}别的{/i}方法……可都没用。

lines.en: : Nothing gets me to where I want to be...And even if I {i}did{/i} manage to get skinnier, I’m not sure if there would {i}be{/i} a place I can be happy with at all.
lines.zh: : 没有什么能把我带到我想去的地方……而且就算我{i}真的{/i}瘦下来了,我也不确定是否{i}存在{/i}一个能让我真正开心的位置。

lines.en: : What if I...{i}always{/i} see myself as a freak?
lines.zh: : 要是我……{i}永远{/i}都把自己看成怪物呢?

lines.en: : Don’t use that word...
lines.zh: : 别用那个词……

lines.en: : I’m sorry...I’ve...
lines.zh: : 对不起……我……

lines.en: : I’ve already told Sensei in the past that I’m going to try and talk a little bit better about myself...it’s just hard...
lines.zh: : 我以前就跟 Sensei 说过,我会试着用更好一点的方式谈论自己……只是很难……

lines.en: : And...talking about it with someone like you...someone who’s just so stunning in every single way...makes me feel like I’m complaining when-
lines.zh: : 而且……和你这样的人说这些……一个在各方面都耀眼得不可思议的人……让我觉得自己在抱怨,明明——

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath17
: Miss...Imai?
lines.zh: : Imai……老师?

lines.en: : Hold whatever thought you have, Futaba. I’m coming to the other side of the rock.
lines.zh: : 把你脑子里那句话先留住,Futaba。我要到石头那边去。

lines.en: : It’s...okay if you stay over there. I can talk louder if you need me to. And I’d...I’d actually...{i}prefer{/i} you stay over there, since...
lines.zh: : 你……待在那边也可以。你需要的话我可以大点声。而且我……我其实……{i}更希望{/i}你待在那边,因为……

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath18
: Yeah, I’d prefer that too.
lines.zh: : 是啊,我也更希望这样。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath19
: That’s why I came out here so early after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟我这么早出来就是为了这个。

lines.en: : I don’t really like letting other people see the “real” me.
lines.zh: : 我不太喜欢让别人看见『真正的』我。

lines.en: : Buuuuuut...if you’re gonna look up to me and...call me “beautiful” and stuff, I should probably do the right thing and show you that you’re not alone in battling your reflection.
lines.zh: : 不——过呢……既然你这么仰慕我,还……叫我『美』什么的,那我大概该做正确的事,让你知道:在与镜中倒影搏斗这件事上,你并不孤单。

lines.en: : Just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath20
: This...isn’t exactly comfortable for me so...d...don’t feel weird if I have trouble making eye contact.
lines.zh: : 这……对我来说也不太自在,所以……要、要是我很难和你对视,你也别觉得奇怪。

lines.en: : Miss Imai...
lines.zh: : Imai 老师……

lines.en: : Imani is fine...No need to be so formal when we’re naked...
lines.zh: : 叫 Imani 就好……都光着身子了,没必要这么拘谨……

lines.en: : Then...Imani...
lines.zh: : 那……Imani……

lines.en: : You can go ahead and keep ranting. Just because I’m not looking doesn’t mean I’m not listening.
lines.zh: : 你继续说下去也没关系。我不看你不代表我没在听。

lines.en: : I’m done ranting for now...
lines.zh: : 我暂时说完了……

lines.en: : I just want you to know that...you really {i}are{/i} beautiful.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你知道……你真的{i}很美{/i}。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath21
: Th...Thanks, but...you realize {i}I{/i} don’t feel that way, right?...And you realize how it’s the same exact thing for you?
lines.zh: : 谢……谢谢,不过……你知道{i}我{/i}并不这么觉得,对吧?……你也知道这对你来说完全是一样的吧?

lines.en: : Maybe...Maybe you’re right and the two of us will be stuck dodging mirrors for the rest of our lives.
lines.zh: : 也许……也许你是对的,我们两个这辈子都要一直躲着镜子。

lines.en: : And maybe there will be people who shame us or...laugh at us for the way we look, but...
lines.zh: : 也许会有人因为我们长什么样而羞辱我们,或者……嘲笑我们,可是……

lines.en: : We...We can...find solace in the fact that we can see {i}each other{/i} in the light we wish we could see {i}ourselves{/i} in.
lines.zh: : 我们……我们可以……在这样一件事里找到安慰:我们能以{i}自己{/i}渴望被看待的那种光,去看待{i}彼此{/i}。

lines.en: : Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你。

lines.en: : Really.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : Hearing that from...someone who looks at themself the same way I do...
lines.zh: : 从一个用同样目光看待自己的人那里……听到这些话……

lines.en: : It’s comforting.
lines.zh: : 很让人安心。

lines.en: : Like I said...I just wanted to make sure you didn’t feel alone...
lines.zh: : 就像我说的……我只是想确认你不会觉得自己是一个人……

lines.en: : It worked...
lines.zh: : 你做到了……

lines.en: : I don’t feel alone anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不再觉得孤单了。

lines.en: : Cooooool...
scene futabaimanibath22
: Okay! I’m gonna go back to my side of the rock now.
lines.zh: : 好了!我要回我那边的石头去了。

lines.en: : You should stay for a little while longer. It’s easier to talk like this.
lines.zh: : 你该再待一会儿。这样说话更容易。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath23
: Easier for you, maybe. I can count the people who have seen me like this on one hand.
lines.zh: : 也许对你更容易。见过我这样子的人,一只手就数得过来。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad you decided to add me to that hand. And I’m glad I got to see this side of you.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我很高兴你决定把我加进那只手上。也很高兴能看见你的这一面。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath24
: Again, it wasn’t like I was just gonna let you hate yourself all a-
lines.zh: : 再说一次,我也不是要让你一个人一直讨厌自己啊——

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath25
: Yo seriously, though. What the fuck?
lines.zh: : 说真的,搞什么鬼?

lines.en: : They’re G’s, by the way. Not F’s.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句,是 G。不是 F。

lines.en: : Uh-huh. And how old are you again?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。还有,你今年多大来着?

lines.en: : Things not to say in the bath, volume three.
lines.zh: : 浴室里不该说的话,第三卷。

lines.en: : Jesus fuckin’ Christmas, I’d hate to be your shoulders.
lines.zh: : 我的耶稣基督啊,我真不想当你的肩膀。

lines.en: : Oh, Fukuyama’s here as well. Move.
lines.zh: : 哦,Fukuyama 也在。让开。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath26
: Well, that was certainly one of the worst nights of sleep I’ve ever had.
lines.zh: : 嗯,那绝对是我睡过最糟的夜晚之一。

lines.en: : Wakana. You realize we were, like...totally having a moment. Right?
lines.zh: : Wakana。你知道我们刚才,那个……正在进行一个时刻。对吧?

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath27
: Were you? Because it appeared as if you were just staring at her breasts.
lines.zh: : 是吗?在我看来,你只是盯着她的胸在看。

lines.en: : I mean...that was only {i}part{/i} of the moment.
lines.zh: : 那个……那只是那个时刻的{i}一部分{/i}。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : Imani, I know last night may have awoken certain {i}feelings{/i} in you, but I should remind you that, contrary to her buxomness, Fukuyama {i}is,{/i} in fact, still in high school.
lines.zh: : Imani,我知道昨晚也许唤醒了你心里的某些{i}感觉{/i},但我得提醒你:别看她波涛汹涌,Fukuyama {i}事实上{/i}还在上高中。

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath28
: I was just admiring them! It wasn’t weird!
lines.zh: : 我只是在欣赏!又不奇怪!

lines.en: : Did, umm...did something happen in your room last night?...
lines.zh: : 那个,嗯……昨晚你们房间里发生了什么吗?……

lines.en: scene futabaimanibath29
: Yeaaaah, but we’re not gonna talk about that.
lines.zh: : 是啊——不过我们不打算谈那个。

lines.en: : We’re not going to talk about {i}anything.{/i} We’re just going to sit here and relax and be pretty.
lines.zh: : 我们{i}什么{/i}都不会谈。我们只要坐在这儿,放松,漂漂亮亮的。

lines.en: : And formulate our plan to kill Arakawa once everyone wakes up.
lines.zh: : 顺便制定干掉 Arakawa 的计划,等所有人都醒了就动手。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m confused...
lines.zh: : 我有点糊涂……

lines.en: : It’s probably for the best that you remain that way...
lines.zh: : 你继续糊涂下去,大概是最好的……

lines.en: And they all lived happily ever after.
lines.zh: 于是她们从此幸福地生活在一起。

lines.en: For real this time.
lines.zh: 这次是真的。
